title: The Last Thorn Again
premise: Elodie Vasquez, keeper of the sealed border gate and ledger-keeper for the Thorn Guild, which trades in impossible things, discovers the wards fell the same night the stars vanished — sabotaged from inside the guild itself. Hunted by both realms' lawkeepers and betrayed by the guildmaster who raised him, Elodie must gather the covenant's scattered oath-bearers and reforge the broken pact before the moon completes its thirteenth turn, or both realms unravel. In the end, Elodie learns he was born of both realms, the living seal the gate was built around, and he chooses to become the new covenant himself — restoring the stars at the cost of his old identity, walking the border forever as its living thorn.
about_author: Ansel Eastwick is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing border-town legal disputes before turning to fiction. They write fantasy about people who keep records of things the world would rather forget.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. During a routine ledger audit, the gate's wards collapse and the stars vanish; a smuggled oath-bearer dies at his feet clutching a page torn from the covenant. Guildmaster Corvane names Elodie the traitor. The beat is disorientation hardening into resolve: the man who kept the records must now read what they truly say.

chapters.title: Ledgers of Impossible Things
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV, with interludes from lawkeeper Sera Quill hunting him. Fleeing through the guild's hidden archive, Elodie deciphers the torn page and learns the covenant was broken deliberately — and that his own birth is recorded as a guild transaction. The beat is betrayal: every loyalty he trusted was an entry in someone's ledger.

chapters.title: Thirteen Turns of the Moon
chapters.summary: Alternating POV: Elodie and Sera, forced together by Corvane's mercenaries. They gather the remaining oath-bearers and storm the guildhall as the twelfth turn wanes. Elodie confronts Corvane, who reveals Elodie is the living seal the gate was built around. The climax: Sera chooses truth over her oath and stands with him as the moon begins its final turn.

chapters.title: The Living Thorn
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. With Corvane dead and the covenant's ink spent, Elodie offers himself as the new covenant — blood, name, and memory fused into the gate. The stars return one by one; Sera keeps his ledger, recording who he was. The resolution's beat is bittersweet transformation: justice kept outside the law, identity surrendered so both realms can keep their own.
